content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Guides gumroad

Gumroad, for instance, offers a simple, user-friendly interface for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-pakistan-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]] digital products, but it comes with significant limitations. Its fees can range from 3.5% + $0.30 per sale to 8% + $0.30 per sale, depending on the payment method used. Additionally, Gumroad's customer support is limited to email and live chat, leaving creators vulnerable to payment disputes and account freezes. PayPal, on the other hand, provides a more comprehensive payment solution, but its account suspension policies are notoriously strict. A single disputed transaction can result in a 180-day freeze of your funds, with no appeal process. Stripe, while widely available, operates in only 46 countries out of 195 worldwide, leaving many creators in restricted territories without a viable payment option. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle, similarly, have limited global reach and restrictive policies that prioritize their own interests over those of their creators.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, the major platforms tend to employ a range of strategies, from outright blocking to more subtle restrictions. Gumroad, for example, does not explicitly prohibit sales in restricted countries, but its payment processing partners may flag transactions as high-risk, resulting in account freezes or declined payments. PayPal, on the other hand, is more aggressive in its approach, blocking accounts from users in restricted countries without warning. Stripe, while not entirely blocked, operates with significant limitations in restricted territories, often resulting in declined payments or delayed transactions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle follow similar patterns, with varying degrees of restriction and limitation.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

One of the most significant differences between the major platforms is their payment speed, fees, and real costs. Gumroad's fees, while high, are at least transparent. PayPal's fees, on the other hand, can be opaque and subject to change without notice. Stripe's fees, while competitive, come with significant limitations in restricted territories. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle, meanwhile, charge higher fees than Stripe, often with no corresponding increase in features or support. When it comes to real costs, the major platforms often prioritize their own interests over those of their creators, resulting in hidden fees, declined payments, and delayed transactions.
Gumroad's fees are high, but at least transparent.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, the major platforms often fall short. Gumroad's customer support is limited, leaving creators vulnerable to payment disputes and account freezes. PayPal's account suspension policies are notoriously strict, while Stripe's limited global reach results in declined payments and delayed transactions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle, meanwhile, prioritize their own interests over those of their creators, often resulting in hidden fees and declined payments. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution that prioritizes creators' sovereignty and success, providing a complete digital commerce stack with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.

However, if you're looking for a more comprehensive payment solution with greater control over your business, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a better choice.
